G1_unambiguity.justification: The panel, control group, ECL, ACL, and validity condition are all defined precisely, leaving only one reasonable interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: It includes the necessary input bounds, event constraints, formulas, output requirements, and acceptance condition.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Writing the panel-panel, panel-control, and control-control event counts as \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\) makes ECL equal to \(9a+10b+11c\) and ACL equal to \(5a+10b+11c\), so equality holds exactly when \(a=0\), which is precisely the original all-strangers condition.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is grammatically clear and coherent, though the engineered terminology and unexplained coefficients make it feel somewhat contrived.
